title: Invoice Terms and Due Dates on the Commercial Credit Account
content:
An invoice posts only to a Commercial Credit Account whose status is active, on hold or in collections. The account's status in the system record decides this, on the account the invoice is billed to.

### Due date

1. Every invoice falls due the tier's net terms days in calendar days after its invoice date; with monthly consolidated billing all shipments and services of a calendar month are billed on one invoice dated the last calendar day of that month and the due date is counted from that date.
2. Counting starts the day after the invoice date and the due date is the date reached after the tier's net terms days, with no adjustment for weekends or holidays.
3. An invoice is past due from the day after its due date.

### Invoice total

The invoice total is the merchandise amount plus the freight amount plus the sales tax amount; freight and tax are billed exactly as the originating program or ship-to policy determines and are never re-priced on the credit account.

### Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Invoice date | Net terms days | Due date | First day past due |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 1st of a 30-day month | 10 | the 11th of that month | the 12th |
| the last day of a calendar month (consolidated invoice) | 30 | the date 30 days later | the day after that date |

A due date that falls on a Saturday stays on that Saturday.

*Hypothetical total:* merchandise 800.00, freight 40.00 and sales tax 56.00 make an invoice total of 896.00.

### Status check

| Account status | Invoice posts? |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| on hold | yes |
| in collections | yes |
| applied, declined or closed | no |
